data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006 and SRC_007 share a mechanism of comparative-directionality failure but differ in error type: SRC_006 mis-segments the sentence (dropping 'more than the pen' and treating $10 as the notebook's absolute price), while SRC_007 inverts the comparative (assigning the premium to the pen instead of the notebook). SRC_006 depends on a truncation error, SRC_007 on a directional inversion. This is refuted if both error types collapse to the same misparse, or if either artifact's mechanism is shown to produce a different algebraic structure.
